import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final double EPS = 1e-9;
    static final double PI = Math.acos(-1.0);
    static final int MOD = 1000 * 1000 * 1000 + 7;
    static final int INF = 2000 * 1000 * 1000;
    static final int MAXN = 210;
    static final int MAXM = 2 * MAXN * MAXN;
    static final int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    static final int S = MAXN - 2;
    static final int T = MAXN - 1;

    static int n, t;
    static char[][] a = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] b = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] dist = new int[15][15];
    static boolean[][] used = new boolean[15][15];
    static MaxFlow maxFlow = new MaxFlow();

    static int sqr(int n) {
        return n * n;
    }

    static class MaxFlow {
        int[] to = new int[MAXM];
        int[] flow = new int[MAXM];
        int[] cap = new int[MAXM];
        int lastEdge;
        ArrayList<Integer>[] g = new ArrayList[MAXN];
        int[] level = new int[MAXN];
        int[] ptr = new int[MAXN];

        MaxFlow() {
            lastEdge = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
            this.to[lastEdge] = to;
            this.flow[lastEdge] = 0;
            this.cap[lastEdge] = cap;
            g[from].add(lastEdge++);

            this.to[lastEdge] = from;
            this.flow[lastEdge] = 0;
            this.cap[lastEdge] = 0;
            g[to].add(lastEdge++);
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int idx : g[v]) {
                    if (level[to[idx]] == -1 && cap[idx] - flow[idx] > 0) {
                        level[to[idx]] = level[v] + 1;
                        q.add(to[idx]);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int v, int t, int f) {
            if (v == t) return f;
            for (; ptr[v] < g[v].size(); ptr[v]++) {
                int idx = g[v].get(ptr[v]);
                if (level[to[idx]] == level[v] + 1 && cap[idx] - flow[idx] > 0) {
                    int pushed = dfs(to[idx], t, Math.min(f, cap[idx] - flow[idx]));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        flow[idx] += pushed;
                        flow[idx ^ 1] -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int getMaxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int flow = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                int pushed;
                while ((pushed = dfs(s, t, INF)) > 0) {
                    flow += pushed;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static boolean ok(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < n &&
               0 <= y && y < n &&
               a[x][y] != 'Y' &&
               a[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfsDeath(int x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                dist[i][j] = INF;

        Queue<Integer> X = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> Y = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[x][y] = 0;
        X.add(x);
        Y.add(y);

        while (!X.isEmpty()) {
            int curx = X.poll();
            int cury = Y.poll();

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int tx = curx + dx[k];
                int ty = cury + dy[k];
                if (ok(tx, ty) && dist[tx][ty] == INF) {
                    dist[tx][ty] = dist[curx][cury] + 1;
                    X.add(tx);
                    Y.add(ty);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void runBFS(int x, int y) {
        Queue<Integer> X = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> Y = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> lev = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(used[i], false);
        used[x][y] = true;
        X.add(x);
        Y.add(y);
        lev.add(0);

        while (!X.isEmpty()) {
            int curx = X.poll();
            int cury = Y.poll();
            int curlev = lev.poll();

            if (Character.isDigit(b[curx][cury]) && b[curx][cury] != '0') {
                maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, sqr(n) + 1 + curx * n + cury, INF);
            }

            if (curlev >= t) continue;

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int tx = curx + dx[k];
                int ty = cury + dy[k];
                if (ok(tx, ty) && !used[tx][ty]) {
                    if (dist[tx][ty] > curlev + 1) {
                        X.add(tx);
                        Y.add(ty);
                        lev.add(curlev + 1);
                    } else if (dist[tx][ty] > curlev && Character.isDigit(b[tx][ty]) && b[tx][ty] != '0') {
                        maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, sqr(n) + 1 + tx * n + ty, INF);
                    }
                    used[tx][ty] = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void build() {
        int posi = -1, posj = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n && posi == -1; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n && posi == -1; j++)
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') { posi = i; posj = j; }

        bfsDeath(posi, posj);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j]) && a[i][j] != '0')
                    maxFlow.addEdge(S, i * n + j, a[i][j] - '0');

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (Character.isDigit(b[i][j]) && b[i][j] != '0')
                    maxFlow.addEdge(i * n + j + sqr(n) + 1, T, b[i][j] - '0');

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j]) && a[i][j] != '0')
                    runBFS(i, j);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        sc.nextLine(); // consume blank line? Actually the input has a blank line after n t? The original reads "\n" after scanf. We'll read the blank line.
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        sc.nextLine(); // blank line
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                b[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        build();
        System.out.println(maxFlow.getMaxFlow(S, T));
        sc.close();
    }
}
